trap.label: could / would (hábito)
trap.wrong: It could water the plants every morning; it would greet she.
trap.right: It could water the plants. Every morning it would greet her.
trap.why: Em português “podia regar” e “cumprimentava” usam imperfeito. Em inglês, could = habilidade passada; would = hábito; pronome após o verbo é objeto (her).

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “It greeted her every morning.”
rewrite.answer: It would greet her every morning.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com could: “It was able to water the plants.”
Reescreva com couldn't: “She was unable to stop smiling.”
